Senate Democrats block data center energy cost legislation

slots.name: legislation status
slots.sentence: The debate over the issue was on full display Wednesday, after Senate Democrats blocked legislation championed by Sen. Jon Husted (R-Ohio) — who is in a competitive reelection bid against former Sen. Sherrod Brown (D-Ohio) — that would require states and some electric utilities to consider a standard under which data centers would have to pay for additional costs caused by their large power demand.
